name: Euler-Bernoulli beam
domain: 车辆—轨道与基础结构动力学
definition_zh: 以忽略横向剪切变形为主要假设的经典梁模型。
usage_overview: 常用于车辆—轨道及桥梁动力分析，以忽略横向剪切变形的梁模型描述钢轨、轨道板、混凝土支承层或桥梁的弯曲响应，也用于模拟离散扣件支撑下的钢轨。

complete_examples.text: Three sleeper element types, namely the rigid-body, extensible Euler-Bernoulli beam and solid element are used respectively in the track system modelling with detail mathematical formulations presented.
In this section, the sleeper is modelled as an extensible Euler-Bernoulli beam.
The rail is modeled as Euler-Bernoulli beam, the concrete track slab and baseplate are modeled as thin-plate elements, and the filling layer is modeled as solid elements.
In this model, the rail is modeled as an Euler-Bernoulli beam, and the track slab and base plate are modelled as plate elements.

The rail is modeled as the Euler-Bernoulli beam, the track slab and baseplate are simulated as plate elements, besides, the rail pads are regarded as the linear spring-dashpot element, and the filling layer be tween the track slab and baseplate is modeled as surface spring-dashpots.
